evals.prompt: Add internationalization to this fresh Next.js App Router app with English and Arabic, Arabic RTL support, locale-prefixed URLs for every locale, and a language switcher in the header.
evals.expected_output: A next-intl setup with centralized locale config, routing/request/navigation modules, proxy or middleware, [locale] layout, messages, RTL dir/font handling, and a switcher that preserves the current pathname.
expectations: Creates a single source of truth for locales including direction metadata
Uses next-intl routing, request config, plugin, and createNavigation helpers
Places public routes under [locale] and sets html lang and dir
Implements a locale switcher without manual URL rewriting
Adds RTL/font strategy and validation steps

evals.prompt: Migrate an existing Next.js 16 App Router project that has public pages, API routes, and a Payload admin area so the public site supports English, Arabic, and French. Keep admin and API routes unlocalized, localize Payload content, and make metadata/caching locale-aware.
evals.expected_output: A migration plan and code patterns that use src/proxy.ts with matcher exclusions, route groups with [locale] only for the frontend, Payload locales derived from i18n config, localized fields/queries, locale-aware cache keys, and localized metadata.
expectations: Uses proxy.ts for Next.js 16 and excludes admin/API/static paths
Derives Payload locales from frontend locale config
Passes locale into CMS queries and cache keys
Keeps CMS content separate from JSON UI messages
Addresses localized metadata and canonical URL policy

evals.prompt: Review this partially internationalized Next.js app. It has next-intl installed, but links are manually prefixed with /en, the language switcher string-replaces pathnames, RTL only works on a few components, and cached CMS queries do not include locale. Tell me what to fix and in what order.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis and ordered remediation workflow that centralizes locale config/navigation, replaces manual links with createNavigation Link, rewrites the switcher to use usePathname plus locale prop, moves RTL to html dir/global/logical utilities, and fixes locale-aware data/cache/metadata.
expectations: Identifies duplicated/manual locale routing as an anti-pattern
Prioritizes source-of-truth config and navigation helpers before component fixes
Fixes language switcher via next-intl Link locale prop
Fixes RTL at html dir plus logical CSS and behavior layers
Adds locale to CMS query and cache boundaries
